derivation: from G1 (Α) (as a negative particle) and G3129 (μανθάνω);

occurrences.text: As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable wrest, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction.
